home.hero_subtitle: Chess Home is a chess platform with intelligent Stockfish analysis, a handy position editor, and real-time online play. Built for players who take the game seriously.
home.feature_engine_desc: A world-class engine analyzes every move right in your browser. Position evaluation, best move, lines up to 20+ moves deep.
home.feature_online_desc: Play live opponents in real time. Elo rating system, multiple time controls.
home.feature_editor_desc: Build any position from scratch, load it via FEN, and analyze it instantly with the engine.
home.feature_history_desc: Full move history in PGN format with move-tree navigation. Scroll through any position.
home.feature_rating_desc: A fair rating system. Win, climb the ranks. Find opponents at your level.
home.feature_russian_desc: The first chess site originally built for the Russian-speaking community, now open to everyone.
home.chat_login_hint: Sign in to join the chat
home.onboarding_w1_text: A new platform for chess battles, community, deep Stockfish analysis and tactical puzzles.
home.onboarding_w2_text: We value your privacy and never share unnecessary data with third parties. We recommend reading our policy documents so you can play with peace of mind.
home.onboarding_w3_text:
🏆
You can draw arrows and circles on the board and set premoves — everything for your convenience!
⚙️
Fine-tuning — open the «More» tab (Settings) to change the board theme, sounds and animations to your liking.
🧩
Puzzle Storm — a great way to warm up your brain before a game!
home.onboarding_done_text: We wish you beautiful games, brilliant tactics and bright victories on the board.
home.security_alert_text: If you already had an account and were logged in — please sign in again. Some features will not work until you re-login: we have seriously upgraded our security system, including the JWT token. If you find any bug — please report it to us. Thank you for understanding!
home.policy_banner_text: The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy were updated on June 12, 2025. By continuing to use Chess Home you accept the new terms.

ai.commentator_idle: Make a move and I'll comment on it…
ai.phrase_greeting_1: I'm ready, the engine is warm. Show me the position! ♟️
ai.phrase_greeting_2: Hi! I'm looking at the board through your eyes… almost.
ai.phrase_greeting_3: Evaluation ready. Spoiler: someone is about to slip here.
ai.phrase_mate_1: Checkmate! This board belongs in a museum. 👑
ai.phrase_mate_2: M-a-t-e. Time for the king to rest.
ai.phrase_mate_3: Mate found — nothing left to analyze! 😄
ai.phrase_blunder_white_1: Whoa! Big swing towards White — someone just blundered. 😬
ai.phrase_blunder_black_2: White blundered so hard that Black started doubting it.
ai.phrase_blunder_white_3: The eval flew to White — that was loud. Very loud.
ai.phrase_blunder_black_1: Whoa! Big swing towards Black — rough day for White. 😬
ai.phrase_blunder_black_3: The eval dove to Black — trouble, but the game lives on!
ai.phrase_swing_white_1: White's advantage keeps growing — the position feels warmer for them.
ai.phrase_swing_white_2: White squeezed out more than expected. Not bad!
ai.phrase_swing_white_3: The scales are tilting towards White.
ai.phrase_swing_black_1: Black grabs the initiative — it doesn't get more interesting!
ai.phrase_swing_black_2: Black is playing sharp, and the eval agrees.
ai.phrase_swing_black_3: Now it's Black who is smiling at the position.
ai.phrase_small_1: A small imbalance in the position — keeping an eye on it. 🔍
ai.phrase_small_2: The eval edged up a little. Nothing decisive, but nice.
ai.phrase_small_3: The position wobbled slightly — let's keep watching.
ai.phrase_quiet_1: A quiet move. All according to the classics so far.
ai.phrase_quiet_2: The eval barely moved — equilibrium holds.
ai.phrase_quiet_3: Calm waters. Don't catch me on boring positions…
ai.phrase_quiet_4: The position is stable, but not for long. ♟️
ai.phrase_idle_1: I'm no Stockfish, but something tells me it's interesting here!
ai.phrase_idle_2: My algorithm is 87% sure you know the Legal's mate. 😏
ai.phrase_idle_3: The analysis goes on, and I'm off for a coffee. ☕
